create_rotation_matrix: create a 4x4 rotation matrix from an angle, direction vector, and optional pivot point
convert_quaternion_to_matrix: convert a quaternion [x, y, z, w] into a 4x4 homogeneous rotation matrix
convert_euler_to_matrix: create a 4x4 rotation matrix from Euler angles with a specified axis sequence like sxyz
decompose_transformation_matrix: decompose a 4x4 transformation matrix into scale, shear, Euler angles, translation, and perspective components
compute_superimposition_matrix: compute the optimal transformation matrix to superimpose one set of 3D vectors onto another
